Max Verstappen won three of the five races held at Circuit Park Zandvoort between 2000 and 2025 (2021, 2022, and 2023). Lando Norris won in 2024 and Oscar Piastri in 2025, so no one else has more than one win there.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
